name: Zecs
source:
"Your hesitation will eventually cost you your life. You absolutely must kill your next enemy."

The CEO of Bountia, the Hunters organization.
He is retired from hunting now, but he used to be a legendary hunter who went by the codename "X Living Mythology".

Age: [spoiler]31[/spoiler]
Real Name: [spoiler]Alexandria Wiseman[/spoiler]
